description: One place for every mod's settings.

settings.label: Show MODS in the pause menu
settings.tooltip: Turn off only if you set a key below, or you will have no way to open this menu.

settings.label: Open key (optional)
settings.tooltip: Opens this menu anywhere, including the main menu. Avoid F10 and F11.

settings.label: Menu size
settings.tooltip: Size of this menu as a percentage. It resizes as you drag, and will not grow past what fits on your screen.
